configuracion.title: DeCA configuration
configuracion.subtitle: Adjust the public visibility of the QR and the module's notifications.
configuracion.tarjeta_acceso_publico_desc: How long the DeCA stays accessible without login via the QR, and how long the data of whoever downloads it is kept.
configuracion.ayuda_dias_visibilidad: Legal minimum under the DeCA regulation: 7 days. Default: 10.
configuracion.label_dias_retencion_ip: Days of retention of the download IP
configuracion.label_horas_max_edicion: Hours to correct an already-generated DeCA
configuracion.ayuda_horas_max_edicion: After generating the official DeCA, how many hours a wrong field can still be corrected (e.g. the driver calls right after leaving) without cancelling the shipment. Each correction regenerates the PDF and logs the user who made it. 0 = cannot be corrected, locked instantly as before.
configuracion.ayuda_dias_retencion_ip: How long the IP of whoever downloads the DeCA via the QR is kept, for data minimization (GDPR). No legal minimum. Default: 365 days.
configuracion.tarjeta_notificaciones_desc: Choose which channel notifies each party when a DeCA is generated.
configuracion.bloque_conductor_desc: Notifying the driver is always mandatory -- here you only choose the channel.
configuracion.bloque_cliente_desc: Also notify the consignee when the DeCA is generated.
configuracion.bloque_transportista_desc: Also notify the carrier when the DeCA is generated.
configuracion.tarjeta_repositorio_desc: Where the obligation to keep the DeCA comes from, and where to connect an external repository (Google Drive) if you want a copy outside Appodo.
configuracion.repositorio_procedimiento_titulo: What the regulation requires (Resolution of 5 June 2026, BOE-A-2026-12784)
configuracion.repositorio_procedimiento_1: The PDF must be digitally native (never scanned) and under 5 MB.
configuracion.repositorio_procedimiento_2: The QR must download the PDF DIRECTLY when the URL is invoked -- no login, no buttons or intermediate pages.
configuracion.repositorio_procedimiento_3: That login-free access only holds during the window configured above (legal minimum 7 days after the transport ends).
configuracion.repositorio_procedimiento_4: The document must be kept for a full year, even once it's no longer reachable via the public QR -- that's why a copy in your own repository (Drive), not just in Appodo, is worth having.
configuracion.gdrive_deca_desc: Appodo already stores the generated DeCA. This is optional: if you connect Drive and pick a folder, every generated DeCA is also copied there.
configuracion.gdrive_no_configurado: Google Drive integration is not configured in this environment.
configuracion.gdrive_no_conectado_desc: No Google Drive account connected yet for this company.
configuracion.gdrive_se_gestiona_en: the connection is managed from My Account.
configuracion.gdrive_error_carpeta: Could not save the Drive folder.
configuracion.gdrive_elegir_carpeta_ayuda: Pick a folder that already exists in your Drive.
configuracion.gdrive_crear_carpeta_ayuda: Or let Appodo create a new folder dedicated to DeCA.
configuracion.tarjeta_rol_desc: What you usually are in your shipments. It decides which field is pre-filled with your own tax ID and how the tax IDs read by the automatic extraction are assigned. You can always correct it by hand on a given shipment.
configuracion.ayuda_rol_habitual: Issuing the DeCA is an obligation of both at once: the contractual shipper and the effective carrier are jointly liable if it is missing.
configuracion.tarjeta_cabecera_desc: Optional: add a quality-system-style header (code, version, edition...) to the exported Expeditions and Agenda PDFs, instead of the plain title.
configuracion.tarjeta_identificador_desc: Which number identifies a shipment for the customer: in the email subject, the PDF file name and the audit history. If the chosen field is empty on a given shipment, the next available one is used (waybill → CMR → automatic counter) — it's never left blank.
configuracion.ayuda_identificador_automatico: The automatic counter only numbers when Generating the DeCA (never in Draft), and only when the shipment doesn't already have its own delivery note or CMR number.
configuracion.tarjeta_plantilla_email_desc: Optional: customize the subject and message the DeCA is sent with by email. Empty = the standard Appodo message is used (subject = shipment reference, as chosen above under "Shipment reference").
configuracion.plantilla_cuerpo_placeholder: Attached is the DeCA for shipment {identificador}...

ayuda_deca.boton: Does this transport need a DeCA?
ayuda_deca.titulo: Does this transport need a DeCA?
ayuda_deca.intro: The DeCA is required for PUBLIC road haulage: when a transport company carries someone else's goods for a price.
si: Truck, lorry or articulated unit (tractor + semi-trailer) carrying someone else's goods.
Van over 2 tonnes maximum authorised mass (MAM) carrying someone else's goods.
no: Van up to 2 tonnes MAM (up to 2.5 t if electric, gas or another alternative fuel): no transport licence needed.
The customer comes with their own vehicle to collect their own goods (private transport).
Parcel and courier services (collection and delivery of shipments).
ayuda_deca.cmr: If the transport already carries a consignment note (CMR) with all the required data, that note works as the control document.
ayuda_deca.vehiculo_unico: Van or truck without trailer: enter its plate in "Vehicle plate" and tick "No trailer".
ayuda_deca.fuente: Order FOM/2861/2012, arts. 1, 2 and 6; Land Transport Regulation, art. 33.2.d. The MAM is in the vehicle documents. If in doubt, carry it.

campo.cfg_subtitulo: What happens when the DeCA is made at the farm, the dock or in the field without signal, and other ways of working away from the office.
campo.cfg_modo_titulo: No signal: what does the phone do?
campo.cfg_modo_desc: Choose one option only: they are different ways of solving the same thing. It applies to creating a DeCA from the phone.
campo.modo_imprimir_desc: Filled in offline and printed on the spot, with its QR (site wifi/bluetooth printer or "Save as PDF"). The truck leaves with the paper; the QR starts leading to the DeCA as soon as the phone gets signal again and registers it in Appodo. This is a contingency solution: the regulation requires the document to be downloadable during an inspection, and until the phone registers it the QR does not download it yet.
campo.modo_generar_al_volver: Save and generate when back online
campo.modo_generar_al_volver_desc: Filled in offline but NOT printed: it is saved on the phone and the DeCA with its QR is generated as soon as there is signal. Only useful if the truck waits for the DeCA or there is signal before it leaves: with no paper or QR on board, the transport has no DeCA.
campo.modo_necesita_red_desc: Without signal the DeCA cannot be made: the phone says so. For companies that want no document outside the system. The truck cannot leave until there is signal to generate the DeCA with its QR.
campo.cfg_ejemplares_desc: How many copies are printed offline. The carrier copy travels in the truck (always printed); the others have signature boxes for whoever keeps them.
campo.cfg_ejemplares_solo_imprimir: Only used with "Print on the phone".
campo.cfg_papel_desc: If someone fills in a DeCA by hand on the paper pad, a photo is taken later and it is registered in Appodo as a "Paper DeCA", with the same mandatory data, to keep a record. Careful: from 5 October 2026 a handwritten DeCA is NOT a valid DeCA (the regulation requires a native PDF with QR, does not accept scans and disregards handwritten notes): registering it here keeps an internal record, it does not make it valid. Needs signal to upload the photo.
campo.cfg_anticipado_desc: Lets you prepare and generate the DeCA at the office before the truck arrives, marking the weight as estimated ("Estimated weight" in the form; the PDF shows "(estimado)"). The real weight is entered later within the hours allowed to correct a generated DeCA.
campo.cfg_anticipado_legal: Careful: the regulation requires the weight of what is transported (art. 6.d). The real weight must be entered BEFORE the truck leaves, and the paper or QR the driver carries must be the corrected one. If you cannot ensure that, keep it off.
campo.cfg_anticipado_sin_ventana: Cannot be enabled: "Hours to correct a generated DeCA" is 0, and without that window there would be no way to enter the real weight.
campo.cfg_aviso_desc: Emails the installation administrators when a DeCA made offline reaches Appodo but could not be generated because something is missing, and is still like that after the given days. One alert per DeCA.
campo.leyenda_modo: "No signal: what does the phone do?" is single choice: selecting one option clears the others, because they are mutually exclusive ways of solving the same thing.
campo.leyenda_interruptores: Cards with a switch (on/off) are independent: they can be on at the same time and combined with any mode. A greyed-out card depends on another option, and its text says which.
campo.leyenda_defecto: Factory defaults: print on the phone, 2 copies, incomplete DeCA alert after 2 days; paper pad by photo and advance DeCA off.
campo.leyenda_norma: Legal basis (Orden FOM/2861/2012 and Resolution of 5 June 2026, BOE-A-2026-12784): the DeCA is generated as a native PDF with QR before the service starts; the driver carries a copy with the QR (on the phone or printed) and handwritten notes do not count; the document must be downloadable through the QR during inspections and for at least 7 days after the service; if corrected during the service, the PDF itself shows the reason and the previous data as no longer valid; it is kept for one year.
campo.leyenda_movil: Each phone gets ready to work offline by itself when someone signs in to Appodo with signal (any screen), and refreshes every time it is opened with signal; the DeCA start screen on the phone says whether it is ready. When the signal comes back, on Android pending DeCAs are registered by themselves even with the app closed; on iPhone Appodo has to be opened.
campo.leyenda_limite: Appodo cannot see what is on a phone that never gets signal again: the alert only covers what has already arrived. Pending ones are shown on the phone itself, in Shipments.
campo.necesita_red_banner: No signal. Your company has chosen to make DeCAs only with signal: you can keep filling in, but generating it needs signal (or the paper pad).
campo.necesita_red_barra: No signal: generating the DeCA needs signal.
campo.necesita_red_error: The DeCA cannot be generated without signal: your company has set it up this way.
campo.generar_al_volver_banner: No signal. You can fill in the DeCA: it is saved on the phone and generated with its QR as soon as the signal comes back. It is not printed.
campo.guardar_para_luego: Save to generate when back online
campo.guardar_para_luego_desc: There is no signal: the DeCA is saved on the phone and generated, with its PDF and QR, as soon as the signal comes back. Until then there is no DeCA: the truck should not leave without it.
campo.guardado_para_luego_desc: Reference {{referencia}}. It will be generated with its QR as soon as the signal comes back; you will see it in Shipments.
campo.guardado_para_luego_aviso: Until it is generated there is no DeCA. If the truck has to leave now, use the paper pad.
campo.movil_papel_banner: Registering a paper DeCA: copy the data exactly as on the paper. No QR is generated; the photo is kept as the copy.
campo.papel_falta_foto: The photo of the paper DeCA is missing: it is the copy of the document that travelled.
campo.papel_necesita_red: Registering a paper DeCA needs signal to upload the photo.
campo.papel_error: The paper DeCA could not be registered.
campo.peso_estimado: Estimated weight (enter the real one before the truck leaves)
campo.movil_peso_real: It is the real one now
campo.detalle_peso_estimado: Estimated weight: correct it with the real weight (Correct data) before the truck leaves, and make sure the driver carries the corrected DeCA.
campo.detalle_papel: Paper DeCA: filled in on the paper pad and registered later with its photo. It has no Appodo PDF or QR.

campo.preparando: Preparing the phone to work without signal…
campo.no_preparado_sin_red: This phone has no saved address book: without signal you will have to type everything. Next time, just open Appodo with signal before leaving.
campo.agenda_vieja_one: The saved address book is {{count}} day old: open Appodo with signal to update it.
campo.agenda_vieja_other: The saved address book is {{count}} days old: open Appodo with signal to update it.
campo.instalar_app: Install Appodo DeCa on this phone
campo.instalar_app_desc: Installed, it opens without signal and registers offline DeCAs by itself.
campo.guia_titulo: How to set up phones to work without signal
campo.guia_intro: Do it once per phone, with signal and before it goes to the field. Ideally with the worker's phone in front of you: it takes 5 minutes.
campo.guia_android_resumen: Everything works: offline, printing with QR and automatic registration, with the app closed, when the signal returns.
campo.guia_android_1: Open your Appodo DeCa installation's address in Chrome (not another browser) and sign in with that person's user, with signal.
campo.guia_android_2: Go to Shipments → "New DeCA" and tap "Install Appodo DeCa on this phone". If it does not appear: Chrome ⋮ menu → "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".
campo.guia_android_3: From now on always open Appodo from that icon, not from the browser.
campo.guia_android_4: When it asks for notification permission, accept: it tells you when an offline DeCA has been registered.
campo.guia_android_5: In Settings → Battery, remove extreme saving or "restricted" mode from Chrome if set: it can delay background registration.
campo.guia_android_6: Pair the site printer (Settings → Connected devices → Printing, with the manufacturer's print service) or check that it can "Save as PDF".
campo.guia_android_7: Check that the DeCA start screen says "Ready to work without signal".
campo.guia_iphone_resumen: Works offline and prints with QR, but when the signal returns Appodo must be OPENED for it to be registered. On iPhone, Chrome uses the same engine as Safari: it behaves the same.
campo.guia_iphone_1: Open your Appodo DeCa installation's address in Safari or Chrome (no need to sign in yet).
campo.guia_iphone_2: Mandatory: Share button → "Add to Home Screen". If it is only used from the browser, the iPhone deletes the data of a website not opened for 7 days, including DeCAs pending registration.
campo.guia_iphone_3: Open Appodo from that icon and sign in THERE with that person's user, with signal: on iPhone the installed app does not share the session or data with the browser. Always use it from the icon.
campo.guia_iphone_4: When back at the warehouse or in an area with signal, open Appodo: that is when offline DeCAs are registered (the iPhone does not do it in the background).
campo.guia_iphone_5: Check that the printer supports AirPrint and the iPhone can see it (or use "Save to Files" as PDF), and that the DeCA start screen says "Ready to work without signal".
campo.guia_iphone_6: If you can choose, Android is better for field work: registration when the signal returns is automatic.
campo.guia_comun_1: One user per phone. If several people share a phone, each one only sees and sends their own pending DeCAs.
campo.guia_comun_2: Open Appodo with signal at least once a week: the session expires after 7 days unused and nothing is registered until signing in again (pending ones are not lost, they wait).
campo.guia_comun_3: Do not clear the browser data with pending DeCAs: signing out does not delete them, clearing browser data does.
campo.guia_comun_4: Every time Appodo is opened with signal the phone's address book is updated: that is how a new shipper or plate added at the office gets there.
campo.guia_comun_5: Pending ones are shown in Shipments, with the "Register now" button; if one could not be registered, it says why.
campo.guia_comun_6: If a DeCA reaches Appodo but cannot be generated, the administrators get an email (incomplete DeCA alert, above).
campo.guia_prueba_1: With the phone set up, turn on airplane mode.
campo.guia_prueba_2: Open Appodo from the icon → New DeCA → Fill in by hand: the "No signal" notice and the address book with your shippers and plates must show.
campo.guia_prueba_3: Fill in a test DeCA, "Generate and print offline" and print it (or save as PDF): it must include its QR.
campo.guia_prueba_4: Turn off airplane mode (on iPhone, open Appodo) and check in Shipments that it is registered, "Issued offline".
campo.guia_prueba_5: Cancel that test DeCA from its record.
campo.motivo_placeholder: E.g.: real weight after weighing, plate copied wrong…
campo.motivo_ayuda: Mandatory when correcting an already generated DeCA: the reason and the previous data (marked as no longer valid) are added to the DeCA itself, which keeps its QR (Resolution of 5 June 2026, section five). The driver sees the corrected version through the same QR.
campo.motivo_obligatorio: Enter the reason for the correction: the regulation requires it to appear in the DeCA itself.

agenda_manda.titulo: Document reading: the address book takes priority
agenda_manda.desc: When a delivery note or CMR is uploaded or photographed, Appodo fills in the DeCA combining several sources. With this on (recommended), your address book data takes priority over what is read from the document: it avoids errors reading handwriting or mixing up whose tax ID is whose.
agenda_manda.orden_titulo: The order in which Appodo trusts each source
agenda_manda.fuente_persona_desc: Never overwritten: what is already written in the form stays.
agenda_manda.fuente_agenda_desc: Data someone in your company already confirmed in previous DeCAs. If the name read matches a record, its tax ID (and address, for the shipper) is used; if the tax ID read belongs to a record, its name is used. An address-book tax ID is never placed in another company's role.
agenda_manda.fuente_lectura: What was read from the document (automatic reading and AI).
agenda_manda.fuente_lectura_desc: For what the address book does not know: a new company or the first time it appears.
agenda_manda.fuente_orden_desc: Last resort: when tax IDs are found without knowing whose they are, they are distributed in the order they appear and flagged for review.
agenda_manda.avisos_titulo: Notices the person making the DeCA will see
agenda_manda.aviso_distinto: The document says something different from the address book (another tax ID for the same company, or another name for the same tax ID): the address book value is used and an amber notice shows both values to check.
agenda_manda.aviso_ajeno: The reading put in one role the tax ID that, in the address book, belongs to another company (e.g. the customer's tax ID in the carrier): it is not placed, it is left empty and a notice is shown.
agenda_manda.aviso_parecido: The name read is similar to a record but not identical ("Mercadono"): it is filled from the address book and shown in red to confirm.
agenda_manda.leyenda_apagado: Off: the address book only fills the tax ID when the reading did not find it (previous behaviour). Not recommended: a tax ID misread from the paper would reach the DeCA without notice.
agenda_manda.leyenda_agenda: The address book fills itself with every DeCA. Keep it up to date in Address book: if a record has wrong data, it would spread to the following DeCAs. Fix it in the record, not in each DeCA.
agenda_manda.leyenda_matriculas: Plates: current Spanish plates, trailer plates with the leading R (R1234BCD), old provincial plates (CA1234AB) and foreign plates are all valid. If a handwritten plate looks like one in the address book, the address-book one is proposed.
agenda_manda.leyenda_naturaleza: Nature of the goods: the reading writes what the goods are in plain words (the product name is fine), without item codes, references or batch numbers (Orden FOM/2861/2012 art. 6.d; CMR Convention art. 6: "usual description").
agenda_manda.aviso_varios: The same name has several tax IDs in your address book (duplicate or test records): Appodo does not pick one blindly, it warns and asks you to keep only the right one in the address book.
